Mali: no imported Linux Vulkan driver. Import the experimental PanVK package under GPU drivers → Advanced → Runtime driver, then select it.

Experimental Mali/Immortalis (CSF): download the PanVK driver below and start at 720p or 1280x720. Do not turn "Steam interface on the GPU" on - it restarts the phone on Mali; the dma-buf WSI already gives the store its speed. For games: FPS limiter at 60 or Off, FEX preset PERFORMANCE or PERFORMANCE_TSO, and "Wine sync" at fsync or esync (wineserver is the slow path; with nothing picked the session now puts fsync first by itself). Close background apps - a game past ~2.5 GB gets the session killed by Android, and the new lowmem driver cuts texture memory a quarter to a third. Keep HDR and frame generation off.
Software keeps the Mali GPU out of the session entirely: no /dev/mali0, no render node, no probe. It is slow - it exists to check the stack, not to play.
